LanguageData.HE_Albion_MeatPie.label: meat pie
LanguageData.HE_Albion_MeatPie.description: Chunks of meat and onion in thick gravy, sealed in a golden crust. Filling, warm and good for days.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Roast.label: Sunday roast
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Roast.description: Roast meat with a risen batter pudding, greens and gravy. The whole household sits down to it once a week.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Scones.label: tea and scones
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Scones.description: Warm scones with clotted cream and jam and a pot of strong tea. In Albion this counts as a meal and a ceremony at once. A small treat: eating it is a little joy.
